research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TabaPay is researching an authentication system and method described as tap to authenticate technology. The title and abstract show work on enabling consumers to tap their own payment card on their own mobile device to transmit encrypted card data to an acquirer for card authentication. This aims to reduce fraud and errors in account funding and payment transactions, advancing secure card based authentication for account funding and payment processing.
